regions.build_note: Use the owned image inside a sized media slot; CSS clip-path may restore the reference diagonal. Keep overlaid text and calls to action outside the raster.

presentation.crop_contract: Keep the photographed subject and identifying room features legible; maintain source-specific composition at desktop and mobile.
presentation.minimum_visible_fraction: At least 75% of the source-visible photographic subject in the approved live slot; do not invent any occluded anatomy or room detail.

regions.what: candidate replacement for repeated waiting-room photo: compact live location-verification rail

Keep the original reception-2 photo focal in r5 and the gallery heading, location caveat and sole /contact#location-status link live above the photo. Build a short navy/blue angular lower rail: a small unnumbered Client-supplied / Reception view label and distinct orientation to the Contact status categories (address, hours, directions, parking and accessibility). Do not repeat the address caveat or add a second link to the same destination. On mobile, bring the verification detail near the first 844px without shrinking the photo, heading or touch target. No room panorama, new image, invented address or availability. Designer review pending.
